names: Sodium Silicates (i) Sodium silicate (ii) Sodium metasilicate

more_info.overview: This entry groups sodium silicate and sodium metasilicate. Sodium metasilicate is an inorganic silicate salt with both anhydrous and hydrated forms. The broad sodium-silicate name can refer to preparations with different proportions of sodium and silica. The dataset retains their historical anti-caking classification. A precise food-use description would need to identify the actual silicate preparation rather than treat all water-glass materials as identical.
more_info.banned_in:
